data.name: Daeej
data.gender_notes: Daeej is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who calls others to the right path or gives guidance. The name Daeej carries the meaning “Caller, Guide” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Daeej usually hope their child will grow to embody caller, guide and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who is dedicated to helping others find their way to spiritual enlightenment
data.etymology: Daeej belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Caller, Guide.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Daeej total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: داعج
in_arabic.meaning: داعج تعني داعي و حاجي و دعوت دين اسلام
in_arabic.long_meaning: داعج هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الداعي إلى الله ، الحاجي ، المدعو ، و يدل على الشخص الذي يدعو الناس إلى الله تعالى و يرشدهم إلى الطريق المستقيم ، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني دينية و روحانية عالية

in_urdu.name: داعج
in_urdu.meaning: داعج مطلب دعوت دین اسلام ، حجت و دلیل
in_urdu.long_meaning: داعج ایک عربی نام ہے جس کا مطلب ہے داعی الٰہی ، حجت ، دلیل ، اور وہ شخص جو لوگوں کو اللہ کی طرف دعوت دیتا ہے ، اس نام کا انتخاب کرنا خاصی اہمیت کا حامل ہے کیونکہ یہ دینی اور روحانی صدائے قوی پر مبنی ہے

in_hindi.name: दाएज
in_hindi.meaning: दाएज मतलब दावत ए इस्लाम, हज्जत और दलील
in_hindi.long_meaning: दाएज एक अरबी नाम है जिसका अर्थ है ईश्वरीय दावत, हज्जत, दलील, और वह व्यक्ति जो लोगों को ईश्वर की ओर आमंत्रित करता है, इस नाम का चयन करना विशेष महत्व रखता है क्योंकि यह धार्मिक और आध्यात्मिक मूल्यों पर आधारित है

in_pashto.name: داعج
in_pashto.meaning: داعج معنی د دعوت دين اسلام ، حجت او دلیل
in_pashto.long_meaning: داعج د يو عربي نوم دی چی معنی یی دالله دعوت کوونکی ، حجت ، دلیل ، او هغه څوک چی خلکو ته الله تعالی طرف دعوت ورکوي ، دے ، دا نوم خاصه اهمیت لری ځکه چی دا په دیني او روحاني معنا توکی جوړ دی

in_english.name: Daeej
in_english.long_meaning: Daeej is an Arabic name that signifies 'one who calls to Islam', 'proof', or 'evidence'. It etymologically stems from the Arabic root 'د ع ج' which connotes the act of calling, inviting, or summoning. Historically, this name has been associated with individuals who have played pivotal roles in spreading Islamic teachings and guiding people towards righteousness. The name embodies spiritual significance, reflecting qualities of leadership, wisdom, and devotion to faith.

data.cultural_impact: The name Daeej holds a significant cultural importance in Islamic society as it is derived from the Arabic word "Da'wa", which means "calling" or "invitation" to the path of Allah. In Islamic tradition, a Daeej is a devoted and knowledgeable individual who dedicates their time and energy to guide others towards righteousness, through dawah or Da'wa work. Hundreds of thousands of Daeej work tirelessly all around the world, seeking to spread the message of Allah and guide others to the path of peace, love, and God-consciousness.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Daeej carries a profound spiritual significance as it represents a commitment to fulfilling the divine purpose of spreading love, knowledge, and truth. In Islamic belief, every person is expected to contribute to the betterment of society and the world, and Daeej takes this calling to heart. By assuming the role of a guide, Daeej is absorbing the attributes of mercy, compassion, and wisdom, while striving to lead others towards Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Caller, Guide" symbolizes One who calls others to the right path or gives guidance. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Daeej serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of caller, guide.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Ibn Abd Al-Hakam, Al-Futuh, (1081 CE) describes Daeej as an Arabic name given to the district of Jerusalem by the Fatimid Caliph Al-Hakim bi-Amr Allah (r. 996-1021 CE). This name was used to distinguish it from the preceding Byzantine rule.
historical_references.context: Fatimid Caliphate in Egypt ruling Jerusalem

historical_references.reference: Ibn Jubayr, The Travels of Ibn Jubayr, (1213 CE) reports the name Daeej as still in use for an area near Jerusalem, which had been a significant military base and administrative center during the Ayyubid period (1171-1341 CE).
historical_references.context: Ayyubid rule in Syria and Egypt

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Daeej' has gained modern significance in the digital world, particularly among Arabic-speaking communities. It refers to a digital influencer or content creator who uses their platform to spread awareness, inspire, and engage with their audience. This term is commonly used in the context of influencer marketing, content production, and digital activism. Arabic influencers, often referred to as 'Daeej', have garnered large followings on YouTube, Instagram, and Twitter, where they create and share content on various topics including fashion, food, travel, and social issues. The use of 'Daeej' reflects the growing importance of digital media in shaping public opinion and driving cultural trends in the Arab world.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Zainab Daeej in Karachi, Pakistan attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Daeej, which means "Caller, Guide". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
